payload.text: 0523 (hv, 2026-09-23: "I need that fixed right now, please"): an intent wb verb that corrects or redacts an item's text. Case 1: the originating event is UNCOMMITTED, so supersede the pending event and leave the old text in no file under intent/. Case 2: the event is COMMITTED, so append a correction event that every render honours. cc builds it end to end, store and CLI, starting as soon as 0521 is banked. BEFORE BUILDING, send vc the proposed name: wb register --correct and the facade's wb_correct (render.rs:4163) already use "correct". ic reviews the surface before the bank. TRAPS: committed means present at HEAD (git cat-file -e HEAD:path), not in the index; verify past intentd's ingest; the verb reaches Gtools only after bin/devbin build all. CHANGELOG under ## [3.2.1] - in progress.
